task_summary: Customer states that the Glass Coffee Carafe from ORD-6023 was damaged in transit. Proper handling is the shipping-damage path: review shipping and return policies, refund the original payment, issue a return label, and add fragile-item goodwill credit where applicable.

Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
